events.title: Monday Kirtan with Akari Tamura
events.description: A weekly kirtan residency at Radiantly Alive Yoga with Ubud's Bhakti musician Akari Tamura (Anandamoyi Dasi). Call-and-response Sanskrit mantra chanting with harmonium and percussion, woven through with storytelling from the Bhakti tradition. Tamura holds three active residencies in Ubud — this Monday slot at Radiantly Alive adds an early-week anchor to her bi-weekly Dragon Tea Temple Wednesday and Sayuri Sunday series. Sessions run 90 minutes.
events.short_description: Weekly Monday kirtan residency with Akari Tamura at Radiantly Alive — Sanskrit mantra, harmonium, Bhakti storytelling.
